scope: Original kit-specific Stat Focus A/B desk research. Each entry compares an existing source-linked community starting choice with an alternative at equal resources; no gameplay measurements, rights clearance or best-in-slot claim.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: For Guillotine (Deathless), a Critical Rating trial changes eligible would-be critical event frequency; it must not be assumed to increase noncritical debuff tick damage. Keep the source-linked setup constant: Attack to accumulate Souls and critical-hit Degeneration. Compare Critical Damage Rating against the same opponent, rank and resources. Record Soul spending and any critical-hit Degeneration before attributing changes to the selected Stat Focus.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: For Guillotine (Deathless) on defense, Armor Rating reduces eligible incoming damage without creating an Armor Up buff or blocking Armor Break. Kit limitation: Souls expire over time; critical prevention reduces Degeneration applications. Compare Block Proficiency using the same attack type, defensive sequence, relic state and node; no across-mode ranking or gameplay result is claimed.
statFocusRecommendation.note: Original dated kit-aware editorial comparison; based on the cited champion rotation and Kabam Stat Focus design, not independent combat tests. Existing community setting remains a hypothesis; Critical Rating versus Critical Damage Rating and Armor Rating versus Block Proficiency are falsifiable alternatives.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: For Guillotine 2099, a Critical Rating trial changes eligible would-be critical event frequency; it must not be assumed to increase noncritical debuff tick damage. Keep the source-linked setup constant: Choose pre-fights while keeping any Digi-Souls needed for armor or recovery. Compare Critical Damage Rating against the same opponent, rank and resources. Guillotine 2099 does not naturally crit; its ordinary basic-hit Degeneration chance scales with Critical Rating. Test that chance separately from any Huntress pre-fight guaranteed critical hits.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: For Guillotine 2099 on defense, Armor Penetration may improve the defender's outgoing direct hits against armored attackers; it does not reduce incoming damage, so a mitigation choice is a real alternative. Kit limitation: Losing the combo wastes ramp; stun interrupts self-repair. Compare Block Proficiency using the same attack type, defensive sequence, relic state and node; no across-mode ranking or gameplay result is claimed.
